critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/income/index.tsx (331 lines): well-structured, all data-testids in place. Minor: line 196 uses formatINR(total).replace('.00','') for donut center — works but a dedicated rounded-integer helper would be cleaner.

/app/frontend/app/income/add.tsx (391 lines): line 99 builds labels=['recurring','freq:<frequency>'] correctly matching backend IncomeCreate labels[] contract. line 112 sends labels:null when empty — backend will accept; OK. EDGE CASE: when editing an income that previously had labels and user toggles recurring OFF, the new payload sends labels:null which CORRECTLY clears the labels in PUT.

/app/frontend/app/income/add.tsx line 109: sends date as date.toISOString() (full ISO datetime). Verify backend IncomeCreate.date accepts ISO datetime vs date-only — could be a silent compatibility issue if backend strips time portion.

/app/frontend/app/income/index.tsx line 70: pctVsLast = Math.round(((total - prevTotal) / prevTotal) * 1000) / 10 — division by zero is guarded (prevTotal > 0 check) but the formatted display uses .toFixed(1) which is fine.

All 5 new income files use Promise.all for parallel fetches — good. Error handling uses empty-catch / fallback to empty arrays — acceptable for read-only screens but PUT/POST/DELETE paths DO surface backend errors via Alert.alert, good.
